vizLead: Use the arrows beside the flow meter to choose its type, then set connector threads and the installation device above. Small gaps between the parts keep every connector easy to identify.
vizNoScript: Enable JavaScript to cycle through flow meter types with the arrows and change connector threads. A compact water meter with external threads is shown by default.
